meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (J560/06, Thursday 15 May 2025). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: Higher partner of J560/03. 100 marks, read from the [N] part markers in the QP margin.

coding_notes: TIER CROSSOVER: q1, q2, q3, q4, q6, q8 and q9 are the same questions as J560/03 q16, q17, q18, q23, q24, q25 and q26, with identical marks and identical tags.

q10 (a cube whose surface area equals a sphere's) tagged surface_area_of_a_sphere + areas_of_squares_and_rectangles: the taxonomy has surface area nodes for spheres, cones and cylinders but NONE for a cuboid or cube, so the 6x-squared half is carried by areas_of_squares_and_rectangles. A genuine gap.

q16a (sketch y = -x squared) tagged quadratic_functions, whose own example is sketching a quadratic. It credits nine skills, including factorising_quadratics, which a student sketching a bare parabola has not demonstrated — but sketching_functions credits Understanding Straight Line Graphs instead, which is no better. The exact node was preferred.

q20a and q20b (area under a rate-of-flow graph, then the average rate over the whole period) tagged kinematic_graphs — the same nearest-fit substitution as J560/04 q21: no node exists for area under a non-kinematic rate graph, and kinematic_graphs is the only node about reading rates off graphs.
q12 (kinematics formulae supplied) tagged substitution + solving_linear_equations, NOT kinematic_graphs — there is no graph, only two formulae to substitute into in sequence.
q14 (write a large number as a product of primes, given one power) tagged prime_factor_decomposition + indices.
q7 and q25 both mix a ratio with percentages of the whole; both are tagged ratio first so they file under Ratio and Proportion, with the percentage skill second.
q23 RETAGGED to exponential_graphs (was growth_and_decay) when exponential_graphs was added to data/skills.ts — a and b of T = ab^n from two points on a cooling curve.
